dict.string: MyFitPlate uses the camera to scan food and supplement barcodes and analyze meal, label, menu, receipt, and recipe photos before you review and log nutrition.
MyFitPlate reads workouts, activity, sleep, heart rate, and body measurements from Apple Health to build fitness, recovery, and wellness insights.
MyFitPlate saves workouts, nutrition, hydration, and body measurements you choose to record to Apple Health so your data stays synchronized.
MyFitPlate uses your location to track your route, distance, and pace while you record a run. Location is only used during an active recording.
MyFitPlate uses the microphone so you can log food by speaking while a recording is active.
MyFitPlate lets you choose meal, label, menu, receipt, and recipe photos from your library for nutrition analysis before you review and log them.
Your speech is transcribed on-device or by Apple to turn what you say into a food search.
